design.settlement_verification: result field vs terminal price convergence (no independent esports truth feed — weaker than the MLB boxscore standard)

payload.statement: KXCS2GAME (esports; reference_solved=False — no mature public model) shows a price-band calibration gap that CLEARS its own measured round-trip cost floor, unlike every reference_solved=True market this program has tested (BTC 15m, BTC 1h, weather, MLB), where the gap is real but smaller than the fee.
payload.verdict_rule: SUPPORTS belief_solved_reference if >=1 cell has |realized - implied| > that cell's measured cost floor AND survives Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at 10% with n>=200. CONTRADICTS if zero cells qualify (esports behaves like the solved-reference markets, so reference-solvedness is not what determines beatability). INCONCLUSIVE if fewer than 5 evaluable cells.

payload.verdict: SUPPORTS_belief_solved_reference: esports shows a cost-clearing calibration gap that solved-reference markets do not

payload.belief_effect: belief_solved_reference must NOT gain its contrast group from this study; it returns to NEEDS_CONTRAST_EXPERIMENT.
payload.defect_1_lookahead: Horizons were anchored to Kalshi's close_time, which is a MEDIAN 6.5h AFTER the ticker-scheduled match time (p10 310min, p90 490min). So T-10m/T-30m/T-60m are post-match for most markets: median price decidedness |mid-0.5|*2 is 0.91 at T-10m and 0.99 at T-5m. The measured 'gap' is the residual spread on an ALREADY-KNOWN outcome, not a forecasting edge. Same artifact class as the full-candle-range look-ahead this program caught on 2026-06-09.
payload.defect_2_paired_observations: 1,509 matches produced 3,017 markets — 1,506 events carry exactly two complementary markets (one per team). Effective n is HALF the n used; the normal-approx p-values and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR assumed independence and are invalid. The longshot-overpriced / favorite-underpriced symmetry is one finding double-counted with opposite signs, not two independent findings.
payload.subject: esports_calibration_contrast
payload.what_was_wrong: The 2026-08-02 run reported SUPPORTS_belief_solved_reference (14/16 qualifying cells, gaps up to 12pp). That verdict is INVALID — two defects in the pre-registered design, both found in post-verdict diagnostics, neither caused by the data.
payload.why_not: Only 47/3017 markets (1.6%) have any candle before the scheduled match start, because collection was anchored to close-125min. Re-anchoring requires recollection, not re-analysis.

payload.verdict: INVALID (retracted): look-ahead — horizons anchored to close_time, median 6.5h after match end; plus paired observations halving effective n. Not evidence in either direction.
